welcome.title: Welcome to the Plein
welcome.intro: Plein is an open-source super-app: one place where services run as mini-apps, with you in charge of every permission. This is the public phase-0 demo — everything you see genuinely works, with test money.
welcome.get1: Two working mini-apps: a shopping list (identity + storage) and a payment demo using the Mollie test environment.
welcome.get2: The real permission model: every mini-app has to ask you first — and denying genuinely works too.
welcome.how2: Your sign-in code appears right on the screen — we do not send email.
welcome.how3: Open the mini-apps and allow or deny permissions per action.
welcome.dataTitle: What we do with your email address
welcome.data1: Only used as your sign-in name for this demo; no email is ever sent to it.
welcome.data2: Not stored in a database and never used for newsletters or marketing.
welcome.data3: Your lists and permission choices live locally in your browser, not on our server.
welcome.expect1: Payments use the Mollie TEST environment: no real money is ever charged.
welcome.expect2: This is a phase-0 demo: it may occasionally reset or change.
welcome.expect3: Want to learn more or build a mini-app? Visit
